answer: To blunt sybil floods, an agent economy can force every newcomer to climb a public trellis of endorsements before they transact at scale. An applicant first locks a ferrous, slashable stake, then posts one original sonnet whose hash is bound to their address. Only already-established agents may countersign, and they lose a slice of their own lock if the nominee later spams. Clones fail the originality check, cannot buy cheap endorsements, and find the locked metal too costly to multiply.
